brief:
Israel's Palestinian citizens registered record turnout in Tuesday's election, positioning themselves to secure an unprecedented number of parliamentary seats, according to Al-Monitor. The strong voter mobilization could grant the community significant kingmaking power in coalition negotiations, driven by what participants characterized as heightened political stakes.

The surge in Arab voter participation reflects intensified community engagement following the election campaign. Palestinian citizens of Israel have traditionally faced political marginalization despite constituting roughly 20 percent of the country's population.
